beats.text: Out of 208 countries and territories, 45 have falling populations.
On this map, yellow marks 163 countries and territories growing at or above 0, and dark blue marks 45 shrinking countries.
Moldova sits at the bottom, shrinking by 1.75%.
China is also shrinking by 0.17%, while Japan is shrinking by 0.49%.
India and the USA are growing, with India at 0.89% and the USA at 0.52%.
This measures the annual rate of population change by counting all residents, regardless of legal status or citizenship.
